m: 1. निर्—ऊढ mfn. unmarried, W.
2. नि-˚रूढ mfn. (cf. निर्-ऊढ, p. 540, col. 3) grown up, BhP.
conventional, accepted (as a word or its meaning, opp. to यौगिक, q.v.), Dāyabh.; Sarvad.
नि-˚रूढ m. (in rhet.) the force or application of words according to their natural or received meanings, W.
(in logic) the inherence of any property in the term implying it (as of redness in the word ‘red’ &c.), ib.
3. निर्-˚ऊढ mfn. drawn out, put aside, separate, Gaut.
purged, Car.; Suśr.
eviscerated (cf. comp.)
a: निरूढ — a. 1 Conventional, become current in popular usage, accepted (as the meaning of a word, as opposed to its यौगिक or etymological sense); द्यौर्न काचिदथवास्ति निरूढा सैव सा चलति यत्र हि चित्तं N. 5. 57. --2 Unmarried. --3 Drawn out, purged. --ढः 1 Inherence (as of ‘redness’ in the word ‘red’). --2 (In Rhet.) The accepted and popular meaning of a word. --Comp. --लक्षणा a lakṣaṇā or secondary use of a word which is based not on the vivakṣā or particular intention of the speaker, but on its accepted and popular sense.

m: निर्-˚ऊढ—शिरस् mfn. (निर्-) with the head laid apart, ŚBr.

v: strI nirUQA SaktitulyA lakzaRA । vyARaraRakopAdihetutaH prasidDArTe SaktitulyAyAM lakzaRArUpAyAM SabdasvArTaboDanASaktO ।
m: नि-˚रूढ—लक्षणा f. (in rhet.) the secondary use of a word which is based not on the particular intention of the speaker but on its accepted and popular usage.
नि-˚रूढ—मूल mfn. firmly rooted, BhP.

a: निरूढिः — f. 1 Fame, celebrity. --2 Familiarity, conversancy, proficiency; नृप विद्यासु निरूढिमागता Ki. 2. 6. --3 Confirmation. --4 = निरूढलक्षणा q. v.

निर्-√ 1. ऊह् P. Ā. -ऊहति, ˚ते, (inf. निर्-ऊहितवै, ŚBr. ind.p. -उह्य, ib.; Pass. pr. p. उह्यमान, KātyŚr.), to push or draw out, put aside or apart, remove, AV.; ŚBr.; ŚrS. : Caus. -ऊहयति, to cause to draw out or purge, Suśr.

s: puM, (nir + Uha SUnye + GaY .) vastiBedaH । yaTA, -- “vastirdviDAnuvAsAKyo nirUhaScetisaMjYitaH । yaH snehErdIyate sa syAdanuvAsananAmakaH । kazAyakzIratElEryo nirUhaH sa nigadyate ॥” iti sArakOmudI ॥ aTa nirUhavastikarmmaviDiH । Atreya uvAca । “caturaNgulAM veRumayIM nAqIM pratilakzaRaM kftvA taTA vastipratikarmma kuryyAt । nAticozRe ca kAle ca na SIte naca Bojite । na nidrAdO na mUtrArtte vizWArtte naca vedaBAk ॥ vastikarmmanirUhaYca kArayettaM nirasya ca । AdO mUtravizWotsargaM kftvA gudaM prakzAlya nAtiSiTilaSayyAyAM SAyayitvA vAmANge vAmapAdaM dakziRANge dakziRapAdaYca saNkocya jaNGopari saMsTApya gudAByantare dvyaNgulamAtrAM nAqIM suDIH saYcArayet । tataH SanEH SanEH vastiM nizpIqya dbipalaparimitatElena nirUhaM kuryyAt । nirUhAnantaraM SanEH SanEruttAnaM SAyayitvorqGIkftya ca paScAt saNkocya pARiBiH paYcavArAn sPikpiRqAn trowayet । tataH svasTaM kftvA kzaRenApyAmASayaM malasTAnaM boDayati । vastyudaravAtAn dozAn nivArayati । paRqitAstaM vastinirUhaM tadvastikarmma ca viduH .” iti hArItottare sUtrasTAne tftIyo'DyAyaH ॥ “naro viriktastu nirUhadAnaM vivarjjayet saptadinAnyavaSyam । SudDo virekeRa nirUhadAnaM tadDyasya SUnyaM vikfzecCarIram ॥” “viSvaksTitaM dozacayaM nirasya sarvvAn vikArAn SamayennirUhaH । dehe nirUheRa viSudDamArge sasnehanaM varRavalapradaSca ॥” iti sidDisTAne praTame'DyAye ॥ “sasEnDavakzOdrayutaH satElo deyo nirUho balavarRakArI । AnAhapArSvAmayayonidozAn gulmAnudAvarttarujaYca hanyAt ॥ yazwyAhvamUlAzwapalena sidDaM payaH SatAhvAPalapippalIBiH । yuktaM sasarpirmaDuvAtaraktaH vEsvaryyavIsarpahito nirUhaH ॥” iti sidDisTAne tftIye'DyAye carakeRoktam ॥) UhaSUnyaH । niScitam । iti medinI । he, 18 ॥ nigrahaH । tarkaH । iti hemacandraH ॥

yaTApramARaguRavihitaH snehavastivikalpo'nuvAsanaH pAdAvakfzwaH । anuvasannapi na duzyatyanudivasaM vA dIyate ityanuvAsanaH । tasyApi vikalpo'rdDArdDamAtrAvakfzwo'parihAryyo mAtrAvastiriti” । “nirUhaH nirUhapratyAga manakAlastu muhUrtto Bavati । “anena viDinA vastiM dadyAdvastiviSAradaH । dvitIyaM vA tftIyaM vA caturTaM vA yaTArTataH । samyagnirUQaliNge tu prApte vastiM nivArayet । api hInakramaM kuryyAnna tu kuryyAdanikramam । viSezAtsukumArARAM hInaeva kramo hitaH । yasya syAdvastiratyalpavego hInamalAnilaH । durnirUQaH sa vijYeyo mUtrArttyarucijAqyavAn । yAnyeva prAkprayuktAni yuYjyAdyaTAsvaM snehavastinA । viviktatA manastuzwiH snigDatA vyADinigrahaH । AsTApanasnehavastyoH samyagdAne tu lakzaRam । tadahastasya pavanAdBayaM balavadadizyate । rasOdanastena SastastadahaScAnuvAsanam । paScAdagnibalaM matvA pavanasya ca cezwitam । annopastamBite kozWe snehavastirviDIyate । anAyAntaM muhUrttAttu nirUhaM SoDanErharet । tIkzRErnirUhErmatimAn kzAramUtrAmlasaMyutEH । viguKAnilavizwavyaM ciraM tizWannirUhacam । SUlA'ratijvarAnAhaM maraRaM vA pravarttayet । tattu Buktavate deyamAsTApanamiti sTitiH । visUcikAM vA janayecCardiM vApi sudAruRam । kopayetsarvadozAnvA tasya hadyAdamojine । jIrRAnnasyASaye dozAH puMsaH pravyaktimAgatAH । niHSezAH suSfmAyAnti BojanenAprapIqitAH । na vAsTApanavikziptamakzamagniH praDAvati । tasmAdAsTApanaM deyaM nirAhArAya jAnatA । AvasTikaM kramaYcApi matvA kAyaM nirUhaRam । male'pakfzwe'dozARAM balavattvaM na vidyate” । vastiBedaSca (picakArI) KyAtaH “vastirdviDAnuvAsyAKyonirUhaSceti saMjYitaH । yaH snehErdIyate sa syAdanuvAsananAmakaH । kazAyakzIratElESca nirUhaH sa nigadyate” iti vedyasArakO॰ । lyuw । nirUhaRamapyatra na॰
m: 1. निर्—ऊह m. a complete sentence, one having no ellipsis, W.
2. निर्-˚ऊह m. a purging clyster, an enema not of an oily kind, Suśr.
= नि-ग्रह, L.
3. निर्-ऊह m. (निर्- √ 2. ऊह्) logic, disputation, W.
certainty, ascertainment, ib.
निर्-ऊह mfn. = निश्-चित, L.
a: निरूहः — 1 An enema not of an oily kind. --2 Logic, disputation. --3 Certainty, ascertainment. --4 A purging clyster. --5 A sentence having no ellipsis, a complete sentence.

m: 1. निर्-˚ऊहण n. causing to purge with a clyster, Suśr.
a purging cl˚, Car.
2. निर्-ऊहण n. ascertainment, W.
a: निरूहणं — 1 Ascertainment. --2 Administering enemas not of an oily kind. --3 Causing to purge with a clyster.

m: 1. निर्-˚ऊह—वस्ति-विधि m. N. of ch. of ŚārṅgS.
निर्-˚ऊहित mfn. purged, Suśr.

नि-√ रूप् P. -रूपयति, to perform, represent on the stage, act, gesticulate, indicate or exhibit by gestures (e.g. रथ-वेगम्, the swiftness of a carriage; वृक्ष-सेचनम्, the watering of a tree, Śak.); to perceive, notice, find out, ascertain, Hariv.; Kāv. &c.; to investigate, examine, search, try, consider, reflect upon, Kāv.; Suśr.; Sarvad. &c.; to state, define, Pañc.; Pur.; Śaṃk.; to select, choose, appoint as (double acc.), appoint to (loc., dat. or inf.), Kāv.; Pañc. &c.
a: निरूप् — {c10c} U. 1 To see, perceive, mark or observe carefully; न च महावने पंथा निरूपितः K. 120. --2 To investigate, examine, look out for, search. --3 To fix upon, determine, settle, resolve. --4 To choose, select, appoint. --5 To reflect, consider. --6 To act, represent dramatically, gesticulate. --7 To perform.
